<!doctype html>

<html lang="en">

<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <title>TripLink</title>
  <script src="../assets/site-switch.js"></script>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <link rel="icon" href="https://dimg04.tripcdn.com/images/1vf3o12000n7g87kxDA4D.svg" type="image/svg+xml">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link rel="stylesheet"
    href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="../tokens.css">
  <style>
    :root {
      --fs-giant: clamp(3.5rem, 8vw, 7.5rem);
      --card-ratio: 1.586;
      --tw: clamp(12.5rem, 22vw, 21rem);
      --frame-inset: var(--sp-8);
      --nav-h: var(--sp-64);

      --c-head: var(--c-fg);
      --c-node: var(--c-accent);
      --g-mark: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--c-accent) 0%, var(--c-accent-dark) 100%);

      --c-ground-soft: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-paper-alt) 42%, var(--c-paper));

      --g-core: var(--c-accent);
      --g-deep: color-mix(in oklab, var(--c-accent) 86%, var(--c-ink));
      --g-lift: color-mix(in oklab, var(--c-accent) 78%, var(--c-paper));
      --g-edge: color-mix(in oklab, var(--c-accent) 62%, var(--c-accent-dark));
      --g-rim: color-mix(in oklab, var(--c-accent-dark) 20%, var(--c-paper));
    }

    [data-color-scheme="scheme-2"] {
      --c-bg: var(--c-ground-soft);
    }

    [data-color-scheme="scheme-3"] {
      --c-head: var(--c-fg);
      --c-node: var(--c-accent-dark);
      --g-mark: var(--c-accent-dark);
      --c-focus: var(--c-accent-dark);
    }

    *,
    *::before,
    *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    html {
      overflow-x: clip;
      -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
    }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      background: var(--c-paper);
      color: var(--c-ink);
      font-family: var(--f-body);
      font-size: var(--fs-16);
      line-height: var(--lh-body);
      letter-spacing: var(--ls-body);
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }

    h1,
    h2,
    h3,
    p,
    ol,
    ul,
    dl,
    dd,
    figure,
    blockquote {
      margin: 0;
    }

    ol,
    ul {
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    img,
    svg {
      display: block;
    }

    a {
      color: inherit;
    }

    :focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--c-focus);
      outline-offset: 2px;
      border-radius: var(--r-4);
    }

    .nav[data-tone="photo"],
    .nav[data-tone="dark"],
    .js .nav.is-open,
    .is-cine .cover__copy,
    .is-mcover .cover__copy {
      --c-focus: var(--c-accent-dark);
    }

    ::selection {
      background: var(--c-accent);
      color: var(--c-accent-ink);
    }

    .num {
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums;
    }

    .vh {
      position: absolute;
      width: 1px;
      height: 1px;
      overflow: hidden;
      clip-path: inset(50%);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .t-giant {
      font-size: var(--fs-giant);
      line-height: 1;
      font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      color: var(--c-head);
    }

    .t-display {
      font-size: var(--fs-h1-page);
      line-height: var(--lh-display);
      font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
      letter-spacing: var(--ls-tight);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .t-title {
      font-size: var(--fs-h2);
      line-height: var(--lh-title);
      font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
      letter-spacing: var(--ls-tight);
      text-wrap: balance;
      color: var(--c-head);
    }

    .t-sub {
      font-size: var(--step-1);
      line-height: var(--lh-title);
      font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
      letter-spacing: var(--ls-tight);
    }

    .t-lede {
      font-size: var(--fs-18);
      color: var(--c-fg-soft);
      max-width: var(--measure-lede);
      text-wrap: pretty;
    }

    .t-body {
      color: var(--c-fg-soft);
      max-width: var(--measure-body);
      text-wrap: pretty;
    }

    .t-meta {
      font-size: var(--fs-14);
      line-height: var(--lh-title);
      color: var(--c-fg-soft);
    }

    .sq {
      display: inline-block;
      flex: none;
      width: var(--sp-8);
      height: var(--sp-8);
      border-radius: calc(var(--sp-8) * 0.18);
      background: var(--g-mark);
    }

    .sq--ok {
      background: var(--c-green);
    }

    .sq--idle {
      background: var(--c-line);
    }

    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      min-height: var(--sp-48);
      padding-inline: var(--sp-24);
      border-radius: var(--r-btn);
      background: var(--c-btn);
      color: var(--c-btn-ink);
      font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: background-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease), color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
    }

    .btn--paper {
      background: var(--c-paper);
      color: var(--c-ink);
    }

    .btn--ghost {
      background: transparent;
      color: inherit;
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px currentColor;
    }

    @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
      .btn:hover {
        background: var(--c-fg);
        color: var(--c-bg);
      }

      .btn--paper:hover {
        background: var(--c-ink);
        color: var(--c-paper);
      }

      .btn--ghost:hover {
        background: var(--c-paper);
        color: var(--c-ink);
      }

      .link:hover svg {
        transform: translateX(var(--sp-4));
      }
    }

    .link {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--sp-8);
      min-height: var(--sp-48);
      font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
      text-decoration: underline;
      text-decoration-color: var(--c-border);
      text-underline-offset: 5px;
      color: var(--c-fg);
    }

    .link svg {
      flex: none;
      width: var(--sp-16);
      height: var(--sp-16);
      fill: var(--c-node);
      transition: transform var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
    }

    .ph {
      overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: var(--r-panel);
      background: var(--c-ink);
    }

    .ph img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
    }

    img[src*="why-finance"] {
      object-position: 50% 12%;
    }

    img[src*="why-call"] {
      object-position: 50% 34%;
    }

    img[src*="why-team"] {
      object-position: 50% 45%;
    }

    img[src*="tile-colleagues"] {
      object-position: 50% 40%;
    }

    img[src*="sol-travel-airport"] {
      object-position: 50% 12%;
    }

    img[src*="sol-payables-office"] {
      object-position: 50% 56%;
    }

    img[src*="why-data"] {
      object-position: 50% 30%;
    }

    img[src*="tile-leisure"] {
      object-position: 50% 45%;
    }

    .ph video {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
    }

    video::-webkit-media-controls {
      display: none;
    }

    .film__btn {
      position: absolute;
      right: var(--sp-12);
      bottom: var(--sp-12);
      z-index: 3;
      width: calc(var(--sp-40) + var(--sp-4));
      height: calc(var(--sp-40) + var(--sp-4));
      padding: 0;
      border: 0;
      background: none;
      color: var(--c-paper);
      cursor: pointer;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      opacity: .7;
      transition: opacity var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
    }

    .film__btn[hidden] {
      display: none;
    }

    .film__btn::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: var(--sp-4);
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-paper) 22%, transparent);
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-ink) 62%, transparent);
    }

    .film__btn svg {
      position: relative;
      width: var(--sp-12);
      height: var(--sp-12);
      fill: currentColor;
    }

    .film__btn .film__i--play,
    .film__btn[aria-pressed="true"] .film__i--pause {
      display: none;
    }

    .film__btn[aria-pressed="true"] .film__i--play {
      display: block;
    }

    .film__btn:focus-visible {
      opacity: 1;
      outline: 2px solid var(--c-paper);
      outline-offset: calc(var(--sp-4) * -1);
      border-radius: 50%;
    }

    @media (hover: hover) {
      .film__btn:hover {
        opacity: 1;
      }
    }

    .ui-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--sp-8);
    }

    .ui-meta {
      font-size: var(--fs-12);
      color: var(--c-ink-soft);
    }

    .ui-big {
      font-size: var(--fs-28);
      font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
      letter-spacing: var(--ls-tight);
      line-height: var(--lh-display);
      margin-block: var(--sp-8);
    }

    .vcard {
      --w: var(--tw);
      --edge: 6.85cqw;
      --mark-h: max(6cqw, var(--fs-10));
      container-type: inline-size;
      position: relative;
      isolation: isolate;
      text-align: left;
      width: var(--w);
      aspect-ratio: var(--card-ratio);
      padding: calc(var(--w) * 0.06);
      border-radius: 3.7% / 5.87%;
      border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-paper) 28%, transparent);
      color: var(--c-paper);
      line-height: 1.2;
      letter-spacing: var(--ls-body);
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums;
      background:
        linear-gradient(118deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-paper) 15%, transparent) 0%, transparent 30%),
        color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-ink) 88%, var(--c-paper));
      box-shadow: 0 var(--sp-40) var(--sp-80) calc(var(--sp-24) * -1) color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-ink) 55%, transparent), inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-paper) 36%, transparent);
    }

    .vcard__glow {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: -1;
      overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: inherit;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .vcard__glow::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      left: 90%;
      top: 104%;
      width: 190cqw;
      height: 130cqw;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      filter: blur(3cqw);
      --vl-core: var(--c-accent);
      --vl-deep: color-mix(in oklab, var(--c-accent) 86%, var(--c-ink));
      --vl-lift: color-mix(in oklab, var(--c-accent) 78%, var(--c-paper));
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse 30% 34% at 42% 46%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-deep) 70%, transparent) 0%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-deep) 66.5%, transparent) 10%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-deep) 58.8%, transparent) 20%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-deep) 47.6%, transparent) 30%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-deep) 35%, transparent) 40%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-deep) 23.8%, transparent) 50%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-deep) 14.7%, transparent) 60%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-deep) 7.7%, transparent) 70%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-deep) 3.5%, transparent) 80%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-deep) 1.1%, transparent) 90%, transparent 100%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse 44% 40% at 54% 58%, var(--vl-core) 0%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-core) 95%, transparent) 10%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-core) 84%, transparent) 20%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-core) 68%, transparent) 30%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-core) 50%, transparent) 40%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-core) 34%, transparent) 50%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-core) 21%, transparent) 60%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-core) 11%, transparent) 70%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-core) 5%, transparent) 80%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-core) 1.5%, transparent) 90%, transparent 100%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 44% at 46% 40%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-core) 55%, transparent) 0%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-core) 52.2%, transparent) 10%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-core) 46.2%, transparent) 20%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-core) 37.4%, transparent) 30%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-core) 27.5%, transparent) 40%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-core) 18.7%, transparent) 50%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-core) 11.6%, transparent) 60%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-core) 6%, transparent) 70%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-core) 2.8%, transparent) 80%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-core) 0.8%, transparent) 90%, transparent 100%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 50% at 50% 50%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-lift) 38%, transparent) 0%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-lift) 36.1%, transparent) 10%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-lift) 31.9%, transparent) 20%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-lift) 25.8%, transparent) 30%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-lift) 19%, transparent) 40%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-lift) 12.9%, transparent) 50%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-lift) 8%, transparent) 60%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-lift) 4.2%, transparent) 70%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-lift) 1.9%, transparent) 80%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-lift) 0.6%, transparent) 90%, transparent 100%);
    }

    .vcard__logo {
      position: absolute;
      top: var(--edge);
      left: var(--edge);
      height: var(--mark-h);
      width: auto;
    }

    .vcard__virtual {
      position: absolute;
      top: var(--edge);
      right: var(--edge);
      height: var(--mark-h);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      font-size: max(2.7cqw, var(--fs-10));
      font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
      line-height: 1;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: .16em;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .vcard__last4 {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: var(--edge);
      left: var(--edge);
      margin: 0;
      font-size: max(3.8cqw, var(--fs-12));
      font-weight: var(--fw-medium);
      line-height: 1;
      letter-spacing: .04em;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .vcard__dots {
      font-size: .72em;
      letter-spacing: .14em;
      vertical-align: .12em;
      opacity: .72;
    }

    .vcard__chip {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 1;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--sp-8);
      padding: var(--sp-8) var(--sp-12);
      border-radius: var(--r-panel);
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-ink) 88%, transparent);
      font-size: var(--fs-12);
      font-weight: var(--fw-medium);
      color: var(--c-paper);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .vcard__chip i {
      width: var(--sp-8);
      height: var(--sp-8);
      border-radius: calc(var(--sp-8) * 0.18);
      background: var(--c-green);
    }

    .vcard__chip b {
      font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
      margin-left: var(--sp-4);
    }

    .vcard__chip--a {
      top: calc(var(--sp-16) * -1);
      right: calc(var(--sp-48) * -1);
    }

    .vcard__chip--b {
      bottom: calc(var(--sp-16) * -1);
      left: calc(var(--sp-40) * -1);
    }

    .vcard--mini {
      --w: min(62%, 17rem);
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-16);
      box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-paper) 36%, transparent);
    }

    .nav {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: var(--z-nav);
      inset: 0 0 auto;
      height: var(--nav-h);
      padding-inline: var(--gutter);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--sp-32);
      color: var(--c-paper);
      transition: color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
    }

    .js .nav {
      position: fixed;
    }

    .nav__logo {
      position: relative;
      display: block;
      width: 6.5rem;
      aspect-ratio: 99 / 24;
      margin-right: auto;
    }

    .nav__logo img {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: contain;
      object-position: left center;
      transition: opacity var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
    }

    .nav__links {
      display: flex;
      gap: var(--sp-32);
      font-size: var(--fs-14);
      font-weight: var(--fw-medium);
    }

    .nav__links a {
      text-decoration: none;
      padding-block: var(--sp-12);
    }

    .nav .btn {
      min-height: var(--sp-40);
      padding-inline: var(--sp-16);
      font-size: var(--fs-14);
    }

    .nav[data-tone="photo"] .nav__logo .is-colour,
    .nav[data-tone="dark"] .nav__logo .is-colour {
      opacity: 0;
    }

    .nav[data-tone="light"] .nav__logo .is-white {
      opacity: 0;
    }

    .nav[data-tone="photo"] .btn,
    .nav[data-tone="dark"] .btn {
      background: var(--c-paper);
      color: var(--c-ink);
    }

    .nav__links a {
      position: relative;
    }

    .nav__links a::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      bottom: calc(var(--sp-8) + 2px);
      height: 1px;
      background: currentColor;
      transform: scaleX(0);
      transform-origin: 100% 50%;
      transition: transform .35s var(--ease);
    }

    @media (hover: hover) and (min-width: 900px) {

      .nav__links a:hover::after,
      .nav__links a:focus-visible::after {
        transform: scaleX(1);
        transform-origin: 0 50%;
      }

      .nav[data-tone="photo"] .btn:hover,
      .nav[data-tone="dark"] .btn:hover {
        background: var(--c-accent-dark);
        color: var(--c-ink);
      }

      .nav[data-tone="light"] .btn:hover {
        background: var(--c-ink);
        color: var(--c-paper);
      }
    }

    .nav {
      --nav-bg: transparent;
      --nav-img: none;
      --nav-blur: 0px;
      isolation: isolate;
    }

    .nav::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      z-index: -1;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      background-color: var(--nav-bg);
      background-image: var(--nav-img);
      backdrop-filter: blur(var(--nav-blur));
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(var(--nav-blur));
      transition: background-color .45s var(--ease);
    }

    .js .nav.is-tall {
      height: var(--sp-80);
    }

    .js .nav {
      transition: color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease), height .35s var(--ease);
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .js .nav {
        transition: none;
      }
    }

    .nav[data-tone="light"] {
      color: var(--c-ink);
      --nav-bg: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-paper) 82%, transparent);
      --nav-blur: 14px;
    }

    .nav.is-scrolled:not(.over-hero)[data-tone="photo"] {
      --nav-bg: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-ink) 70%, transparent);
      --nav-blur: 14px;
    }

    .nav[data-tone="dark"] {
      --nav-bg: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-ink) 70%, transparent);
      --nav-blur: 14px;
    }

    .nav[data-seam="dark-light"] {
      --nav-bg: transparent;
      --nav-img: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-ink) 70%, transparent) var(--seam), color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-paper) 82%, transparent) var(--seam));
      --nav-blur: 14px;
    }

    .nav[data-seam="light-dark"] {
      --nav-bg: transparent;
      --nav-img: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-paper) 82%, transparent) var(--seam), color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-ink) 70%, transparent) var(--seam));
      --nav-blur: 14px;
    }

    .nav__menu {
      display: none;
    }

    @media (max-width: 899px) {
      .nav {
        gap: var(--sp-12);
      }

      .nav .btn {
        min-height: calc(var(--sp-40) + var(--sp-4));
      }

      .nav__links {
        display: none;
      }

      .nav>.btn {
        display: none;
      }

      .nav__logo {
        width: 5.25rem;
      }

      .js .nav__menu {
        margin-right: calc(var(--sp-12) * -1);
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        gap: var(--sp-8);
        min-width: var(--sp-48);
        min-height: var(--sp-48);
        padding: 0 var(--sp-12);
        font: inherit;
        font-size: var(--fs-14);
        font-weight: var(--fw-medium);
        color: inherit;
        background: none;
        border: 0;
        border-radius: var(--r-btn);
        cursor: pointer;
      }

      .nav__menu i {
        position: relative;
        display: block;
        width: var(--sp-16);
        height: 2px;
        border-radius: var(--r-4);
        background: currentColor;
        transition: background-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
      }

      .nav__menu i::before,
      .nav__menu i::after {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
        width: 100%;
        height: 2px;
        border-radius: inherit;
        background: currentColor;
        transition: transform var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
      }

<!doctype html>

<html lang="en">

<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <title>TripLink</title>
  <script src="../assets/site-switch.js"></script>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <link rel="icon" href="https://dimg04.tripcdn.com/images/1vf3o12000n7g87kxDA4D.svg" type="image/svg+xml">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link rel="stylesheet"
    href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="../tokens.css">
  <style>
    :root {
      --fs-giant: clamp(3.5rem, 8vw, 7.5rem);
      --card-ratio: 1.586;
      --tw: clamp(12.5rem, 22vw, 21rem);
      --frame-inset: var(--sp-8);
      --nav-h: var(--sp-64);

      --c-head: var(--c-fg);
      --c-node: var(--c-accent);
      --g-mark: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--c-accent) 0%, var(--c-accent-dark) 100%);

      --c-ground-soft: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-paper-alt) 42%, var(--c-paper));

      --g-core: var(--c-accent);
      --g-deep: color-mix(in oklab, var(--c-accent) 86%, var(--c-ink));
      --g-lift: color-mix(in oklab, var(--c-accent) 78%, var(--c-paper));
      --g-edge: color-mix(in oklab, var(--c-accent) 62%, var(--c-accent-dark));
      --g-rim: color-mix(in oklab, var(--c-accent-dark) 20%, var(--c-paper));
    }

    [data-color-scheme="scheme-2"] {
      --c-bg: var(--c-ground-soft);
    }

    [data-color-scheme="scheme-3"] {
      --c-head: var(--c-fg);
      --c-node: var(--c-accent-dark);
      --g-mark: var(--c-accent-dark);
      --c-focus: var(--c-accent-dark);
    }

    *,
    *::before,
    *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    html {
      overflow-x: clip;
      -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
    }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      background: var(--c-paper);
      color: var(--c-ink);
      font-family: var(--f-body);
      font-size: var(--fs-16);
      line-height: var(--lh-body);
      letter-spacing: var(--ls-body);
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }

    h1,
    h2,
    h3,
    p,
    ol,
    ul,
    dl,
    dd,
    figure,
    blockquote {
      margin: 0;
    }

    ol,
    ul {
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    img,
    svg {
      display: block;
    }

    a {
      color: inherit;
    }

    :focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--c-focus);
      outline-offset: 2px;
      border-radius: var(--r-4);
    }

    .nav[data-tone="photo"],
    .nav[data-tone="dark"],
    .js .nav.is-open,
    .is-cine .cover__copy,
    .is-mcover .cover__copy {
      --c-focus: var(--c-accent-dark);
    }

    ::selection {
      background: var(--c-accent);
      color: var(--c-accent-ink);
    }

    .num {
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums;
    }

    .vh {
      position: absolute;
      width: 1px;
      height: 1px;
      overflow: hidden;
      clip-path: inset(50%);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .t-giant {
      font-size: var(--fs-giant);
      line-height: 1;
      font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      color: var(--c-head);
    }

    .t-display {
      font-size: var(--fs-h1-page);
      line-height: var(--lh-display);
      font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
      letter-spacing: var(--ls-tight);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .t-title {
      font-size: var(--fs-h2);
      line-height: var(--lh-title);
      font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
      letter-spacing: var(--ls-tight);
      text-wrap: balance;
      color: var(--c-head);
    }

    .t-sub {
      font-size: var(--step-1);
      line-height: var(--lh-title);
      font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
      letter-spacing: var(--ls-tight);
    }

    .t-lede {
      font-size: var(--fs-18);
      color: var(--c-fg-soft);
      max-width: var(--measure-lede);
      text-wrap: pretty;
    }

    .t-body {
      color: var(--c-fg-soft);
      max-width: var(--measure-body);
      text-wrap: pretty;
    }

    .t-meta {
      font-size: var(--fs-14);
      line-height: var(--lh-title);
      color: var(--c-fg-soft);
    }

    .sq {
      display: inline-block;
      flex: none;
      width: var(--sp-8);
      height: var(--sp-8);
      border-radius: calc(var(--sp-8) * 0.18);
      background: var(--g-mark);
    }

    .sq--ok {
      background: var(--c-green);
    }

    .sq--idle {
      background: var(--c-line);
    }

    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      min-height: var(--sp-48);
      padding-inline: var(--sp-24);
      border-radius: var(--r-btn);
      background: var(--c-btn);
      color: var(--c-btn-ink);
      font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: background-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease), color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
    }

    .btn--paper {
      background: var(--c-paper);
      color: var(--c-ink);
    }

    .btn--ghost {
      background: transparent;
      color: inherit;
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px currentColor;
    }

    @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
      .btn:hover {
        background: var(--c-fg);
        color: var(--c-bg);
      }

      .btn--paper:hover {
        background: var(--c-ink);
        color: var(--c-paper);
      }

      .btn--ghost:hover {
        background: var(--c-paper);
        color: var(--c-ink);
      }

      .link:hover svg {
        transform: translateX(var(--sp-4));
      }
    }

    .link {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--sp-8);
      min-height: var(--sp-48);
      font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
      text-decoration: underline;
      text-decoration-color: var(--c-border);
      text-underline-offset: 5px;
      color: var(--c-fg);
    }

    .link svg {
      flex: none;
      width: var(--sp-16);
      height: var(--sp-16);
      fill: var(--c-node);
      transition: transform var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
    }

    .ph {
      overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: var(--r-panel);
      background: var(--c-ink);
    }

    .ph img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
    }

    img[src*="why-finance"] {
      object-position: 50% 12%;
    }

    img[src*="why-call"] {
      object-position: 50% 34%;
    }

    img[src*="why-team"] {
      object-position: 50% 45%;
    }

    img[src*="tile-colleagues"] {
      object-position: 50% 40%;
    }

    img[src*="sol-travel-airport"] {
      object-position: 50% 12%;
    }

    img[src*="sol-payables-office"] {
      object-position: 50% 56%;
    }

    img[src*="why-data"] {
      object-position: 50% 30%;
    }

    img[src*="tile-leisure"] {
      object-position: 50% 45%;
    }

    .ph video {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
    }

    video::-webkit-media-controls {
      display: none;
    }

    .film__btn {
      position: absolute;
      right: var(--sp-12);
      bottom: var(--sp-12);
      z-index: 3;
      width: calc(var(--sp-40) + var(--sp-4));
      height: calc(var(--sp-40) + var(--sp-4));
      padding: 0;
      border: 0;
      background: none;
      color: var(--c-paper);
      cursor: pointer;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      opacity: .7;
      transition: opacity var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
    }

    .film__btn[hidden] {
      display: none;
    }

    .film__btn::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: var(--sp-4);
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-paper) 22%, transparent);
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-ink) 62%, transparent);
    }

    .film__btn svg {
      position: relative;
      width: var(--sp-12);
      height: var(--sp-12);
      fill: currentColor;
    }

    .film__btn .film__i--play,
    .film__btn[aria-pressed="true"] .film__i--pause {
      display: none;
    }

    .film__btn[aria-pressed="true"] .film__i--play {
      display: block;
    }

    .film__btn:focus-visible {
      opacity: 1;
      outline: 2px solid var(--c-paper);
      outline-offset: calc(var(--sp-4) * -1);
      border-radius: 50%;
    }

    @media (hover: hover) {
      .film__btn:hover {
        opacity: 1;
      }
    }

    .ui-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--sp-8);
    }

    .ui-meta {
      font-size: var(--fs-12);
      color: var(--c-ink-soft);
    }

    .ui-big {
      font-size: var(--fs-28);
      font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
      letter-spacing: var(--ls-tight);
      line-height: var(--lh-display);
      margin-block: var(--sp-8);
    }

    .vcard {
      --w: var(--tw);
      --edge: 6.85cqw;
      --mark-h: max(6cqw, var(--fs-10));
      container-type: inline-size;
      position: relative;
      isolation: isolate;

      .nm__t>i {

        align-self: center;
        width: 18px;
        height: 18px;

        right: 0;
        top: 50%;
        height: 2px;
        margin-top: -1px;
        border-radius: 2px;
        background: currentColor;
        transition: transform .3s var(--ease);

      text-decoration: none;

      border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-paper) 50%, transparent);

      height: 14px;
      fill: none;
      stroke: currentColor;
      stroke-width: 2;
    }

    }

    .rail__name {
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rail__name .ffn {
      pointer-events: auto;
    }

<!doctype html>

<html lang="en">

<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <title>TripLink</title>
  <script src="../assets/site-switch.js"></script>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <link rel="icon" href="https://dimg04.tripcdn.com/images/1vf3o12000n7g87kxDA4D.svg" type="image/svg+xml">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link rel="stylesheet"
    href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="../tokens.css">
  <style>
    :root {
      --fs-giant: clamp(3.5rem, 8vw, 7.5rem);
      --card-ratio: 1.586;
      --tw: clamp(12.5rem, 22vw, 21rem);
      --frame-inset: var(--sp-8);
      --nav-h: var(--sp-64);

      --c-head: var(--c-fg);
      --c-node: var(--c-accent);
      --g-mark: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--c-accent) 0%, var(--c-accent-dark) 100%);

      --c-ground-soft: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-paper-alt) 42%, var(--c-paper));

      --g-core: var(--c-accent);
      --g-deep: color-mix(in oklab, var(--c-accent) 86%, var(--c-ink));
      --g-lift: color-mix(in oklab, var(--c-accent) 78%, var(--c-paper));
      --g-edge: color-mix(in oklab, var(--c-accent) 62%, var(--c-accent-dark));
      --g-rim: color-mix(in oklab, var(--c-accent-dark) 20%, var(--c-paper));
    }

    [data-color-scheme="scheme-2"] {
      --c-bg: var(--c-ground-soft);
    }

    [data-color-scheme="scheme-3"] {
      --c-head: var(--c-fg);
      --c-node: var(--c-accent-dark);
      --g-mark: var(--c-accent-dark);
      --c-focus: var(--c-accent-dark);
    }

    *,
    *::before,
    *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    html {
      overflow-x: clip;
      -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
    }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      background: var(--c-paper);
      color: var(--c-ink);
      font-family: var(--f-body);
      font-size: var(--fs-16);
      line-height: var(--lh-body);
      letter-spacing: var(--ls-body);
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }

    h1,
    h2,
    h3,
    p,
    ol,
    ul,
    dl,
    dd,
    figure,
    blockquote {
      margin: 0;
    }

    ol,
    ul {
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    img,
    svg {
      display: block;
    }

    a {
      color: inherit;
    }

    :focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--c-focus);
      outline-offset: 2px;
      border-radius: var(--r-4);
    }

    .nav[data-tone="photo"],
    .nav[data-tone="dark"],
    .js .nav.is-open,
    .is-cine .cover__copy,
    .is-mcover .cover__copy {
      --c-focus: var(--c-accent-dark);
    }

    ::selection {
      background: var(--c-accent);
      color: var(--c-accent-ink);
    }

    .num {
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums;
    }

    .vh {
      position: absolute;
      width: 1px;
      height: 1px;
      overflow: hidden;
      clip-path: inset(50%);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .t-giant {
      font-size: var(--fs-giant);
      line-height: 1;
      font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      color: var(--c-head);
    }

    .t-display {
      font-size: var(--fs-h1-page);
      line-height: var(--lh-display);
      font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
      letter-spacing: var(--ls-tight);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .t-title {
      font-size: var(--fs-h2);
      line-height: var(--lh-title);
      font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
      letter-spacing: var(--ls-tight);
      text-wrap: balance;
      color: var(--c-head);
    }

    .t-sub {
      font-size: var(--step-1);
      line-height: var(--lh-title);
      font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
      letter-spacing: var(--ls-tight);
    }

    .t-lede {
      font-size: var(--fs-18);
      color: var(--c-fg-soft);
      max-width: var(--measure-lede);
      text-wrap: pretty;
    }

    .t-body {
      color: var(--c-fg-soft);
      max-width: var(--measure-body);
      text-wrap: pretty;
    }

    .t-meta {
      font-size: var(--fs-14);
      line-height: var(--lh-title);
      color: var(--c-fg-soft);
    }

    .sq {
      display: inline-block;
      flex: none;
      width: var(--sp-8);
      height: var(--sp-8);
      border-radius: calc(var(--sp-8) * 0.18);
      background: var(--g-mark);
    }

    .sq--ok {
      background: var(--c-green);
    }

    .sq--idle {
      background: var(--c-line);
    }

    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      min-height: var(--sp-48);
      padding-inline: var(--sp-24);
      border-radius: var(--r-btn);
      background: var(--c-btn);
      color: var(--c-btn-ink);
      font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: background-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease), color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
    }

    .btn--paper {
      background: var(--c-paper);
      color: var(--c-ink);
    }

    .btn--ghost {
      background: transparent;
      color: inherit;
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px currentColor;
    }

    @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
      .btn:hover {
        background: var(--c-fg);
        color: var(--c-bg);
      }

      .btn--paper:hover {
        background: var(--c-ink);
        color: var(--c-paper);
      }

      .btn--ghost:hover {
        background: var(--c-paper);
        color: var(--c-ink);
      }

      .link:hover svg {
        transform: translateX(var(--sp-4));
      }
    }

    .link {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--sp-8);
      min-height: var(--sp-48);
      font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
      text-decoration: underline;
      text-decoration-color: var(--c-border);
      text-underline-offset: 5px;
      color: var(--c-fg);
    }

    .link svg {
      flex: none;
      width: var(--sp-16);
      height: var(--sp-16);
      fill: var(--c-node);
      transition: transform var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
    }

    .ph {
      overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: var(--r-panel);
      background: var(--c-ink);
    }

    .ph img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
    }

    img[src*="why-finance"] {
      object-position: 50% 12%;
    }

    img[src*="why-call"] {
      object-position: 50% 34%;
    }

    img[src*="why-team"] {
      object-position: 50% 45%;
    }

    img[src*="tile-colleagues"] {
      object-position: 50% 40%;
    }

    img[src*="sol-travel-airport"] {
      object-position: 50% 12%;
    }

    img[src*="sol-payables-office"] {
      object-position: 50% 56%;
    }

    img[src*="why-data"] {
      object-position: 50% 30%;
    }

    img[src*="tile-leisure"] {
      object-position: 50% 45%;
    }

    .ph video {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
    }

    video::-webkit-media-controls {
      display: none;
    }

    .film__btn {
      position: absolute;
      right: var(--sp-12);
      bottom: var(--sp-12);
      z-index: 3;
      width: calc(var(--sp-40) + var(--sp-4));
      height: calc(var(--sp-40) + var(--sp-4));
      padding: 0;
      border: 0;
      background: none;
      color: var(--c-paper);
      cursor: pointer;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      opacity: .7;
      transition: opacity var(--dur-fast) var(--ease);
    }

    .film__btn[hidden] {
      display: none;
    }

    .film__btn::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: var(--sp-4);
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-paper) 22%, transparent);
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-ink) 62%, transparent);
    }

    .film__btn svg {
      position: relative;

      height: 10px;
      margin-left: -5px;
      background: inherit;
      transform: rotate(45deg);
      border-radius: 2px;
    }

    .ffn-tip.is-below::after {
      bottom: auto;
      top: -5px;
    }

    .foot__hk {
      display: none;
    }

    .site-hk .foot__hk {
      display: grid;
      gap: var(--sp-16);
      margin-top: var(--sp-32);
      padding-top: var(--sp-24);
      border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-paper) 16%, transparent);
    }

    .foot__hk p {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: var(--fs-14);
      color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-paper) 75%, transparent);
    }

    .foot__hk p b {
      color: var(--c-paper);
      font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
    }

    .foot__warn {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: calc(var(--fs-giant) / 2);
      line-height: 1.1;
      font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
      letter-spacing: var(--ls-tight);
      color: var(--c-paper);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    @media (max-width: 899px) {
      .js .nav__links .nav__t {
        display: none !important;
      }

      .nm .nm__cta.btn {
        min-height: 56px;
        padding-inline: var(--sp-32);
        font-size: var(--fs-16);
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 899px) {
      .nm__p a>i {
        display: none !important;
      }
    }

    .foot__old {
      margin: var(--sp-24) 0 0;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .foot__old a {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--sp-8);
      padding: 10px 18px;
      border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-paper) 28%, transparent);
      border-radius: var(--r-pill);
      color: var(--c-paper);
      font-size: var(--fs-14);
      font-weight: var(--fw-medium);
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: background var(--dur-mid) var(--ease), border-color var(--dur-mid) var(--ease);
    }

    .foot__old a:hover {
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-paper) 10%, transparent);
      border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-paper) 50%, transparent);
    }

    .foot__old svg {
      width: 14px;
      height: 14px;
      fill: none;
      stroke: currentColor;
      stroke-width: 2;
    }

    .hero-v2 .cover__frame video {
      object-position: 77% 50%;

    }

    }

    .rail__name {
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rail__name .ffn {
      pointer-events: auto;
    }
